sections.st: What Sets a Specialized Thermoforming Manufacturer Apart
leads: Trizen Packaging is a specialized thermoforming manufacturer in India — a packaging manufacturer with a single, unambiguous specialisation: thermoforming. Not a packaging company that does thermoforming among other processes. A dedicated thermoforming packaging manufacturer, since 2005, in Vapi, Gujarat.

The difference between a differentiated plastic packaging manufacturer and a generalist is the accumulation of 20 years of exclusive focus — the depth of tooling capability, material expertise, and regulatory documentation that comes with it. Here is exactly what makes Trizen's offer different from a generic thermoformer.

sections.st: What This Means in Practice — Real Buyer Scenarios
leads: Value-added custom packaging solutions are easiest to understand through real packaging programme scenarios:

rows: Pharmaceutical company needing both GMP blister and commercial FMCG gift trays
Two separate suppliers. Two qualification audits. Two documentation systems. Two tooling lead times.
One qualification at Vapi covers both GMP blister and commercial gift tray manufacturing. One documentation system. One contact.
Medical device OEM needing Tyvek blister components AND product trays for the same device
Tyvek blister from a regulated specialist. Trays from a standard tray manufacturer. Two audits, two COA chains, two batch record formats.
Both manufactured in Cleanroom Class 8 at Vapi. One supplier qualification. One GMP documentation package.
FMCG brand needing a packaging prototype quickly
Commission tool room for tooling — 6 to 12 weeks. Then commission thermoformer. Two-stage, two-supplier process.
In-house design + in-house CNC tooling + in-house thermoforming at Vapi. Prototype in 7 to 14 business days. One stage.
Automotive OEM needing standard component trays AND ESD-safe ECU packaging
Standard tray supplier for general trays. Separate ESD packaging specialist for ECU packaging. Two suppliers, two tooling relationships.
Both standard thermoformed trays and ESD-modified component trays manufactured at Vapi. One supplier, one documentation system.

sections.st: Premium Custom Packaging — End-to-End from Brief to Delivery
leads: Trizen Packaging is a premium custom packaging manufacturer in India — premium in the sense of what is delivered: packaging engineered for the specific product, application, and regulatory requirement rather than adapted from a standard format.

rows: 1. Brief & Consultation
Review of product sample, application, regulatory requirements, and commercial brief. Material and format recommendation. Free of charge.
Same day or next business day
2. Design
In-house cavity geometry design — depth, wall thickness, insertion/removal features, stacking, sealing flange profile, ESD requirements where applicable.
2–5 business days from brief
3. Prototype Tooling
CNC prototype tooling fabricated in-house at Vapi. No outsourcing. Design specifically for thermoforming cavity geometry.
7–14 business days from approved design
4. Prototype Review
First physical prototype delivered. Dimensional check against product. Up to 2 tooling refinements included for standard specifications.
Refinement within 5 days of feedback
5. Production
Full production under ISO 9001:2015, GMP, or Cleanroom Class 8 as applicable. Complete batch documentation with shipment.
Confirmed at order stage
6. Documentation
GMP batch records, material COAs, in-process QC, and outgoing inspection — delivered with every regulated batch as standard.
With every regulated shipment

faqs.q: What makes Trizen a specialized thermoforming manufacturer in India?
faqs.a: Trizen Packaging is a specialized thermoforming manufacturer in India built on 20 years of exclusive thermoforming focus at Vapi since 2005. Six differentiators: regulated + commercial from one facility, in-house CNC tooling (prototype 7–14 days), 6 complete thermoforming formats, medical device blister components and pharmaceutical GMP simultaneously, 20+ years exclusive specialisation, and three validated certifications (ISO 9001:2015, GMP, Cleanroom Class 8) at one Vapi facility.

faqs.q: How does in-house tooling make Trizen unique?
faqs.a: All thermoforming moulds at Trizen Packaging are designed and CNC-fabricated in-house at Vapi — not outsourced to a third-party tool room. This means: new thermoforming packaging prototype in 7 to 14 business days, tooling designed specifically for thermoforming cavity geometry, and modifications handled without coordination delays between a toolmaker and a thermoformer.
